description: This source file contains functions for translating and generating Open Fronthaul Radio Unit configurations, including MAC address parsing, timing parameter conversions, and configuration assembly for radio units and worker management.

methods.name: parse_mac_address
methods.description: Parses a MAC address string into a byte span, validating length.

methods.name: rx_timing_window_params_us_to_symbols
methods.description: Converts reception window timing parameters from microseconds to symbol counts.

methods.name: tx_timing_window_params_us_to_symbols
methods.description: Converts transmission window timing parameters from microseconds to symbol counts.

methods.name: generate_config
methods.description: Generates a detailed radio unit configuration based on input parameters and cell configurations.

methods.name: generate_ru_ofh_config
methods.description: Creates and returns a complete ru_ofh_configuration object based on input configuration and cells.

methods.name: fill_ofh_worker_manager_config
methods.description: Populates worker_manager_config with radio unit configuration details.
